Bluetooth LE SoC Tool

The Bluetooth LE SoC Tool provides a toolkit for development on the host, used for extending functionality development, user application development, or mass production. This document briefly introduces these tools and their usage. For user manuals of each tool, please refer to the tool user manual in the specific directory. Here is a summary of the tools described:

Brief Description of Tools

File Name

Description

WINDOWS

LINUX

MACOS

Bee MP Tool

Used for R&D debugging or mass production.

√

MPCli Tool

Commond-line version of Bee MP Tool, which used for R&D debugging or mass production.

√

√

√

Flash Map Generate Tool

Used to generate flashmap.ini, flashmap.h, OTAHeader files.

√

MP Pack Tool

Used to merge image files and generate data packet files for MP, OTA, CFU.

√

PackCli Tool

Commond-line version of MP Pack Tool, Used to merge image files and generate data packet files for MP, OTA, CFU.

√

√

√

RF Test Tool

Used for Bluetooth, Zigbee, and other RF performance testing and certification testing such as FCC, BQB, CE, SRRC, KC.

√

Font Convert Tool

Used to convert vector font data to bitmap, output as a .bin file.

√

Image Convert Tool

Used to convert the image files according to the set parameters, output the respective image .bin files, and package the converted .bin files.

√
